messages:
Vivian: Quick sync on SolarFlare case study. We need: recorded interview, an approved 1-line quote, two socials, blog + webinar CTA. Target publish next Tue 9am PT. Who owns scheduling and legal?

Ethan: I can take scheduling. Interview set for Fri 11am PT with their Head of ML. Recording will be audio+transcript ~25m.

Raya: I'll draft the hero and social snippets. Can someone confirm the final performance numbers?

Tom: Metrics confirmed from infra team: steady-state serving cost down 27% and p99 latency improved from 1.2s -> 370ms (~3.2x). Saved ops link: <https://docs.redwood/internal/solarflare-metrics-1781>.

Vivian: good. Raya, aim for a hero line that calls out the percent but be conservative in language (avoid absolutes). Also include: "Join our May 12 webinar" CTA.

Raya: draft hero: "SolarFlare cut p99 inference time by about 3x and reduced serving costs ~27% with Redwood; join our May 12 webinar for a performance deep-dive."

Ethan: added recorder + checklist: <https://drive.redwood/internal/checklists/solarflare-1781>. recorder link and CMS draft are in the folder.

Vivian: Legal heads-up: Courtney, please run the quote through LegalBot. We need signed customer consent and approval by Mon EOD to hit Tue publish.

LegalBot: received. Please submit final quote text via approval form: <https://legal.redwood/submit?case=solarflare-1781>. Typical review 24-48h.

Raya: proposed customer quote: "Working with Redwood reduced our p99 times by about 3x and meaningfully lowered serving spend, which helped us accelerate feature launches." Sending to LegalBot now.

Tom: SalesOps note  set UTM + routing: utm_campaign=solarflare_case, utm_medium=post, source=case_solarflare. Webhook -> #ae-inbox.

SalesOps: HubSpot workflow created: solarflare_case_flow. Test lead delivered to AE queue. Link: <https://hubspot.redwood/workflows/solarflare_case_flow>.

LegalBot: initial review complete  minor wording edits suggested: replace "our" with company name in quote; change "meaningfully" to "by 27%" where numbers are used. Also verify customer name permission.

Raya: updated quote per LegalBot: "Redwood reduced SolarFlare's p99 inference time by about 3x and reduced serving costs by 27%, accelerating feature launches." Resubmitting.

Vivian: perfect. Ethan please confirm we have signed consent uploaded.

Ethan: consent uploaded to approval form and project folder: <https://drive.redwood/content/solarflare-consent.pdf>.

LegalBot: approval granted and archived: <https://legal.redwood/approvals/solarflare-1781/approved.pdf>. Two tiny style edits applied to passive voice; file attached.

Raya: pushing final copy + OG image + two social cards into CMS draft: <https://cms.redwood/drafts/solarflare-1781>. Social variations for X and LinkedIn uploaded.

Tom: I've queued Buffer posts for Tue 9am PT with UTM string appended. Also added the webinar reg link to the blog CTA. Buffer draft: <https://buffer.redwood/drafts/solarflare-1781>.

SalesOps: smoke test passed  webhook latency <150ms, sample lead created with utm_campaign=solarflare_case. Slack AE ping looks good.

Vivian: double-check: 1) CMS draft 2) legal approved 3) HubSpot workflow live 4) Buffer queued 5) assets uploaded. Once all green, flip to publish.

Raya: all green. I'll hit publish at 09:00 PT Tue unless anyone flags.

Ethan: I'll monitor AE queue and standby for any lead surges when it goes live.

Tom: also setting a short-term AE rotation for the first 48h. created calendar block and escalation doc: <https://docs.redwood/internal/ae-escalation>.

Vivian: thanks team  great coordination. I'll post a short announce in #all-hands after publish and close this thread. :sparkles:
